step_by_step_reasoning: The visual diagram shows client applications (an EC2-based app server and an AWS Lambda function) contained within a Clients box, both pointing to a Network Load Balancer (NLB). The NLB forwards queries to an auto-scaled Heimdall Proxy cluster running on EC2 instances. The Proxy cluster communicates with a Primary RDS database and an ElastiCache instance used for pub/sub synchronization and invalidation messages across proxy nodes. Secondary database instances (RDS) are also present in the environment.
